# Taken 2026-10-30 on container 1.6.1 (macOS 27.0.1), by asking the runtime directly and then
# through opossum built from this change. The image is ibmjava:8-jre from Docker Hub, whose index
# lists linux/amd64, linux/ppc64le and linux/s390x and no arm64 (and attestation entries, which
# the refusal does not list). It was not local before the first command, was removed between
# the steps below, and was removed afterwards.
#
# A first pull with no platform is refused with the same wording as a local image
# (platform-several-no-arm64-161.txt). So is the run once the amd64 build alone has been pulled:
# the refusal still lists all three platforms. A pull limited to linux/arm64, which is how
# opossum asks an image whether it has an arm64 build, says `unsupported platform` with the
# arm64 default variant written out (`Optional("v8")`); on 1.4.1, for amd64/busybox, it wrote
# `variant: nil` (platform-unsupported-fresh-pull-141.txt). A pull limited to linux/amd64
# succeeds. No container is left after a refusal.

$ container --version
container CLI version 1.6.1 (build: release, commit: unspeci)

# shape 1: first pull of ibmjava:8-jre (amd64, ppc64le, s390x; no arm64), not local
$ container run --rm --name opossum-probe-run ibmjava:8-jre uname -m
--- exit code: 1
--- stdout ---
--- stderr ---
[0/6] [0s]
[0/6] [1s]
[0/6] [2s]
[0/6] [2s]
Error: image ibmjava:8-jre has multiple platforms ([ContainerizationOCI.Platform(osVersion: nil, osFeatures: nil, variant: nil, _rawOS: "linux", _rawArch: "amd64"), ContainerizationOCI.Platform(osVersion: nil, osFeatures: nil, variant: nil, _rawOS: "linux", _rawArch: "ppc64le"), ContainerizationOCI.Platform(osVersion: nil, osFeatures: nil, variant: nil, _rawOS: "linux", _rawArch: "s390x")]); pass --os/--arch or set a default

# platform-limited pulls (what opossum's planning asks), image not local
$ container image pull --platform linux/arm64 ibmjava:8-jre
--- exit code: 1
--- stdout ---

Error: unsupported platform Platform(osVersion: nil, osFeatures: nil, variant: Optional("v8"), _rawOS: "linux", _rawArch: "arm64")

$ container image pull --platform linux/amd64 ibmjava:8-jre

# now local (amd64 only pulled): run with no platform
$ container run --rm --name opossum-probe-run ibmjava:8-jre uname -m

[0/6] [0s]
Error: image ibmjava:8-jre has multiple platforms ([ContainerizationOCI.Platform(osVersion: nil, osFeatures: nil, variant: nil, _rawOS: "linux", _rawArch: "amd64"), ContainerizationOCI.Platform(osVersion: nil, osFeatures: nil, variant: nil, _rawOS: "linux", _rawArch: "ppc64le"), ContainerizationOCI.Platform(osVersion: nil, osFeatures: nil, variant: nil, _rawOS: "linux", _rawArch: "s390x")]); pass --os/--arch or set a default
